scripts.ui:dev: cd snape_ui && flutter run -t lib/main_dev.dart --flavor dev
scripts.ui:prod: cd snape_ui && flutter run -t lib/main_prod.dart --flavor prod
scripts.build:apk:dev: cd snape_ui && flutter build apk -t lib/main_dev.dart --flavor dev
scripts.build:apk:prod: cd snape_ui && flutter build apk -t lib/main_prod.dart --flavor prod --release
scripts.build:appbundle: cd snape_ui && flutter build appbundle -t lib/main_prod.dart --flavor prod --release
scripts.build:ios:prod: cd snape_ui && flutter build ios -t lib/main_prod.dart --flavor prod --no-codesign
scripts.build:ipa:prod: cd snape_ui && flutter build ipa -t lib/main_prod.dart --flavor prod
